items.name: vois-tokens
items.title: Vois tokens
items.description: Default values for every Vois token, generated from the Vois Figma variables, with a generic blue brand, plus the motion tokens and the shape roles in their own files. Use it when the Vois MCP isn't serving your workspace's live values.

items.name: vois-theme
items.title: Vois theme
items.description: Points every shadcn/ui variable at its Vois token (vois-tokens DS-TOKEN-005). Ships no color values. Import it after Tailwind.

items.name: vois-glass
items.title: Vois glass
items.description: Opt-in frosted glass (vois-tokens DS-GLASS): Tailwind class strings glass.subtle, glass.standard and glass.strong on the --glass-* tokens from Figma. Each starts from an opaque surface, adds blur and saturate only where backdrop-filter works (Tailwind writes the -webkit- twin), and drops them under prefers-reduced-transparency. Needs vois-tokens. The Dropdown Menu, Dialog and Command carry their own copy of their tier for material="glass", so they install without this item.

items.name: vois-spinner
items.title: Vois Spinner
items.description: One open arc turning in a circle (the loading.dev arc, MIT), timed by --motion-duration-spin, still under reduced motion, currentColor, sizes 16/20/24. The Button's loading state uses it.

items.name: vois-button
items.title: Vois Button
items.description: shadcn/ui's Button on Vois tokens: the same variant and size names, heights 28/36/48 (36 is the web default, 48 the native default) and 56 circular, a centered label with 4px sides, leading and trailing icons, a loading state with the Vois spinner, the Vois focus ring and hit area, and a pointer-only press scale timed by the motion tokens. Install vois-spinner with it.

items.name: vois-input
items.title: Vois Input
items.description: shadcn/ui's Input on Vois tokens: 36 (web default), 48 (native) and 32 (compact, inline in tables), with the Figma Input Field states (hover, 2px focus, error via aria-invalid, disabled, read-only, prefill).

items.name: vois-select
items.title: Vois Select
items.description: shadcn/ui's Select (Radix) on Vois tokens: a trigger with the Vois Input heights and states, and a list built like the Figma Dropdown Menu and Menu Item. Install vois-input with it: the trigger imports its field classes.

items.name: vois-checkbox
items.title: Vois Checkbox
items.description: shadcn/ui's Checkbox (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Checkbox set: a 24 box with a 2px inside border, checked and indeterminate marks, disabled, the --control-focus ring, an aux variant for strong backgrounds, and a 44 hit area.

items.name: vois-switch
items.title: Vois Switch
items.description: shadcn/ui's Switch (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Web and iOS Switch sets: 32 x 20 on web and 52 x 32 native, a knob that slides in --motion-duration-fast (still under reduced motion), disabled, the --border-state-focus ring and a 44 hit area. For a setting that takes effect at once.

items.name: vois-radio-group
items.title: Vois Radio Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's RadioGroup (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Radio set: a 22 circle with a 3px --control-border ring that grows to an 8px --control-on ring when selected (a 6px hole), disabled, an aux variant, the --border-state-focus ring, arrow keys with one tab stop, and a 44 hit area.

items.name: vois-tabs
items.title: Vois Tabs
items.description: shadcn/ui's Tabs (Radix) on Vois tokens, in two styles from Figma: pill (the default, the Tab set: 28 or 40 tall, --tab-* fills) and underline (the Tab Nav set: 48 tall, a 2px --border-accent edge when active). Disabled wins over active, and arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: vois-textarea
items.title: Vois Textarea
items.description: shadcn/ui's Textarea on Vois tokens: the Vois Input's box and states, growing with its content (field-sizing: content) from 3 to 12 lines and then scrolling, with a rows and resize fallback for older browsers. Install vois-input with it: it imports the Input's field classes.

items.name: vois-field
items.title: Vois Field
items.description: shadcn/ui's Field parts on Vois tokens, with the Figma Input Label text styles, a required asterisk and FieldControl, which wires the control's id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and aria-required. The error is announced with role="alert".

items.name: vois-accordion
items.title: Vois Accordion
items.description: shadcn/ui's Accordion (Radix) from the Figma Accordian set: each item is a card (Bg-Default, Bg-Subtle on hover), a 20/28 title, a plus that turns into a close icon when open, and a height animation on motion tokens.

items.name: vois-avatar
items.title: Vois Avatar
items.description: shadcn/ui's Avatar (Radix) on Vois tokens: a circle at the --size-avatar-* sizes (24/28/40/56/72, 40 by default) with a ring that keeps stacked avatars apart, initials in the Figma type for each size, and initials, generic and invite fallbacks that show while the image loads or when it fails.

items.name: vois-badge
items.title: Vois Badge
items.description: shadcn/ui's Badge on Vois tokens, from the Figma Labels and Status Labels: solid, soft and outline in the 16 label hues and the status colors (info, positive, warning, negative, neutral, accent, aux), sizes 20 and 24, a pill shape, and states when it is a link or button. shadcn's default, secondary, destructive and outline names still work.

items.name: vois-tooltip
items.title: Vois Tooltip
items.description: shadcn/ui's Tooltip (Radix) on Vois tokens: the Figma Tooltip's dark surface and 12px text on the --z-overlay layer, opening on hover and keyboard focus, kept inside the viewport, with a short fade timed by the motion tokens and none under reduced motion.

items.name: vois-icon-button
items.title: Vois Icon Button
items.description: An icon-only Button with a required label: the label is the accessible name and the tooltip, the variant defaults to ghost, sizes are the Button's icon sizes (28, 36 and 48, each a step up on a coarse pointer, and 56 circular, which stays 56), it is type button by default, and a disabled button's tooltip never opens. Install vois-button and vois-tooltip with it: it imports both.

items.name: vois-input-group
items.title: Vois Input Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's InputGroup on Vois tokens: the Vois Input's box and heights with icons, text, a prefix or a button inside, from the Figma Search, Email, Password, URL and Input Field with Button sets. The box shows the inner input's focus, error, disabled and prefill states via :has(). Install vois-input with it: the group imports its field classes.

items.name: vois-segmented-control
items.title: Vois Segmented Control
items.description: shadcn/ui's ToggleGroup parts (Radix, type single) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Segments set: a 32 tall --segment-inactive track with --shape-subtle ends, a 28 tall --segment-active indicator with a --border-default edge and --shadow-base, focus, disabled, arrow keys with one tab stop, and no way back to no selection once a choice is made.

items.name: vois-toggle-group
items.title: Vois Toggle Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's ToggleGroup parts (Radix, single or multiple) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Toggle Group Button set: joined 40 by 32 outline buttons with one shared --border-default line, --toggle-group-unselected, -hover, -selected and -disabled fills, a 2px --border-state-focus ring, and arrow keys with one tab stop.

items.name: vois-stepper
items.title: Vois Stepper
items.description: The step-progress Stepper from vois-components references/stepper.md (shadcn/ui has none): a nav with an ordered list, 32 markers from the Figma Stepper Dots set for upcoming, current (aria-current="step"), complete and error, 2px connectors from the Stepper Line set, horizontal or vertical, a "Step 2 of 3" line below sm, and optional clickable complete steps.

items.name: vois-choice-list
items.title: Vois Choice List
items.description: Full-width choice rows from the Figma Radio Select and Checkbox Select sets: a 56 row with the radio or checkbox on the left, a 16/24 label and an optional 12/16 description, resting, hover, pressed, active (--select-soft-active with a 2px --border-accent edge), negative, disabled and aux states. ChoiceRadioGroup (one choice, Radix RadioGroup) and ChoiceCheckboxGroup (a value array) share one row style, and the whole row is the click target. Needs vois-radio-group and vois-checkbox.

items.name: vois-choice-card
items.title: Vois Choice Card
items.description: Choice cards from the Figma Radio Card and Checkbox Card sets: --bg-card, --radius-selectors, a 16/24 semibold label, a 14/20 description and an optional body, the radio or checkbox on the right, with resting, hover, active (2px --border-state-active) and focus (2px --border-state-focus) edges. Uses the ChoiceRadioGroup and ChoiceCheckboxGroup groups from vois-choice-list, and the whole card is the click target.

items.name: vois-card
items.title: Vois Card
items.description: shadcn/ui's Card on Vois tokens, from the Figma Card set: the container parts plus an interactive card whose whole surface is one link or button (CardLink), with hover, pressed, focus and disabled looks.

items.name: vois-hover-card
items.title: Vois Hover Card
items.description: shadcn/ui's HoverCard (Radix) on the Figma Popover surface: Bg-Card with a border, a tail, 320 wide, on the overlay layer, kept inside the viewport, with a motion-token fade.

items.name: vois-navigation-menu
items.title: Vois Navigation Menu
items.description: shadcn/ui's NavigationMenu parts (Radix) from the Figma Nav Menu Button, Nav Menu Content Block and Nav Menu: 40 tall triggers with a chevron that turns, one shared viewport panel (--bg-subtle, 24 padding), described link blocks, and a hero column. Adds NavigationMenuTitle, NavigationMenuDescription and NavigationMenuHero.

items.name: vois-calendar
items.title: Vois Calendar
items.description: shadcn/ui's Calendar parts (react-day-picker) from the Figma Calendar Picker: a card with the month and year, two 12 chevrons, 19 by 24 date cells in 10/12 text with hover, selected and disabled looks. The Figma sizes are under the 44 by 44 target size (DS-A11Y-001), so check it before using it on touch.

items.name: vois-pagination
items.title: Vois Pagination
items.description: shadcn/ui's Pagination parts (a nav of links, no Radix) from the Figma Pagination: 32 by 32 numbers with an --action-icon-hover fill on hover, a filled active page, 28 tall Previous and Next with 16 chevrons, and an ellipsis. The active page uses --select-solid-active, not Figma's --action-icon-selected, which gives white text about 3.4:1.

items.name: vois-popover
items.title: Vois Popover
items.description: shadcn/ui's Popover (Radix) on the Figma Popover surface, the same as the Hover Card but opened by a click: Bg-Card with a border, a tail, 320 wide, on the overlay layer, kept inside the viewport, with a motion-token fade.

items.name: vois-panel
items.title: Vois Panel
items.description: A persistent secondary pane (inspector, properties) from the Figma Panel set: the push-panel widths 280, 320 or 400, one inner edge, header, scrolling content and footer.

items.name: vois-page-grid
items.title: Vois Page Grid
items.description: The page grid of vois-tokens grid.md: PageFrame (a size container, the content max, safe-area aware margins from --grid-margin, a fill opt-out) and CollectionGrid (a column count from the DS-GRID-007 formula in CSS, a cap per grid class, a gap from --grid-gutter).

items.name: vois-panel-layout
items.title: Vois Panel Layout
items.description: Places a vois-panel beside the main area by the DS-PANEL rules: push when it fits, a non-modal docked overlay with the Large side shadow when it does not, full screen below md. The numbers come from the token variables. usePanelLayout says whether the app shell shows a sidebar, a rail or a bottom bar.

items.name: vois-button-group
items.title: Vois Button Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's ButtonGroup on Vois tokens, from the Figma Button Group set: Buttons joined into one control with shared edges and an inside focus ring, plus a text segment and a separator. Install vois-button with it.

items.name: vois-collapsible
items.title: Vois Collapsible
items.description: shadcn/ui's Collapsible (Radix) with a height animation on the Vois motion tokens that stops under reduced motion. The trigger has no look of its own.

items.name: vois-scroll-area
items.title: Vois Scroll Area
items.description: shadcn/ui's ScrollArea (Radix) with the Figma Scrollbar: a 16 wide transparent track and an 8 wide capsule thumb in --border-default (3:1 or more), darker on hover and drag, with an inside focus ring on the viewport.

items.name: vois-dropdown-menu
items.title: Vois Dropdown Menu
items.description: shadcn/ui's DropdownMenu (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Dropdown Menu and Menu Item sets: the same list as the Select, with checked and radio items, destructive items, shortcuts, labels, separators and submenus. material="glass" gives the standard glass tier; it needs the vois-tokens glass tokens, not vois-glass.

items.name: vois-menubar
items.title: Vois Menubar
items.description: shadcn/ui's Menubar parts (Radix) from the Figma Menubar, Menubar Item and Menubar Menu: a bordered bar of 12 by 6 triggers, and menus of 40 tall items with shortcuts, a sub menu, checked items and full-width group lines. The roving focus and the open-next-menu behavior are Radix's.

items.name: vois-dialog
items.title: Vois Dialog
items.description: shadcn/ui's Dialog (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Dialog: a --width-dialog-sm (344) card, or --width-dialog-lg (560) with the lg size, on --z-modal over a scrim, with a ghost icon close button (36, 48 on touch), header, footer and a motion-token fade. Install vois-button with it. material="glass" gives the strong glass tier; it needs the vois-tokens glass tokens, not vois-glass.

items.name: vois-alert-dialog
items.title: Vois Alert Dialog
items.description: shadcn/ui's AlertDialog (Radix) on the Vois Dialog surface from the Figma Dialog: a --width-dialog-sm (344) card on --z-modal over a scrim, no close button, the alertdialog role, a press on the scrim does nothing, and Action and Cancel as Buttons (Cancel is focused on open). Install vois-button with it. For a destructive confirmation, pass variant="destructive" to the Action.

items.name: vois-toast
items.title: Vois Toast
items.description: Radix Toast on Vois tokens, from the Figma Toast Notification set: a 312 wide box in five states (default dark, notice, negative, positive, info), a 24 icon before the message and a close button after it, --shadow-large, a slide-in. It has ToastProvider, ToastViewport, Toast, ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastAction and ToastClose, and no imperative toast() call.

items.name: vois-command
items.title: Vois Command
items.description: shadcn/ui's Command (cmdk) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Command Menu: a 56 tall search row, a 12-padded list with group headings, 40 tall items with hover and pressed fills and a keyboard ring, and a CommandDialog. Install vois-dialog with it. material="glass" gives the strong glass tier; it needs the vois-tokens glass tokens, not vois-glass.

items.name: vois-slider
items.title: Vois Slider
items.description: Two sliders on a native range input: Slider for a continuous value (a 4px track and a 20 thumb on the Control tokens) and StepSlider for a short named scale (the Segments geometry with stop dots and the step's label in the thumb). Keyboard, touch and the slider role come from the browser.

items.name: vois-inspector
items.title: Vois Inspector
items.description: The inside of a properties pane: collapsible sections of label and control rows, joined control groups and a 32 toggle button. Put it in vois-panel. Install vois-collapsible with it: the sections import it.

items.name: vois-swatch-picker
items.title: Vois Swatch Picker
items.description: Picks one color from a fixed set, with an optional None: a field trigger that shows the swatch and its name, and a popover of swatch groups that is one radio group. Install vois-input with it: the trigger imports its field classes.

items.name: vois-questionnaire
items.title: Vois Questionnaire
items.description: The respondent side of a survey, intake form, quiz or poll (vois-patterns PATH-H, vois-tokens questionnaire-ui.md): Question (picks the right component from the question), ChoiceGroup (radio or checkbox rows, 56px, with a selection limit and an exclusive option), LikertScale (5 or 7 points), LikertBattery (one statement at a time), TapToRank (press and hold to drag, with up and down buttons), PollResults (how others answered, with the correct answer marked) and FieldShell (legend, Required or Optional, helper). The picking logic is the vois-patterns question engine, copied byte for byte. Default copy lives in copy.ts and follows the righter questionnaire entries; pass your own strings to override.
